faq.title: Questions we often get.
faq.1.q: What tent sizes do you have?
faq.1.a: Arabian tents are 20' × 20' and Marquee block tents are 20' × 40'. Both come in white or transparent, and you can book several tents side by side for bigger events.
faq.2.a: It depends on the package. Many packages include tables, chairs and a free buffet table; the tent-only packages are clearly marked. You can always add more from our add-on list.
faq.3.q: Can I add decorations or lighting to a basic package?
faq.3.a: Yes. Fairy and patio lights, curtain deco, underlayer, chandeliers, chair covers and ribbons can be added to any Arabian or Block package.
faq.4.q: How much do LED screens and sound cost?
faq.4.a: LED screens are charged at RM350 per m². Sound and lighting depend on your venue and programme, so we quote each event. Our three technical packages are a good starting point.
faq.5.a: WhatsApp us on +6014-957 6683 with your date, venue and guest count. We'll confirm availability and send you a quote.
